If you're using an iPhone 16 or newer, you might consider pairing it with a Qi2.2 charger to take full advantage of the 25W MagSafe charging speeds your phone supports. Anker's latest 25W Prime MagSafe three-in-one charger is a solid option, with an extremely portable design.

First impressions

The major trend in the second half of 2025 is bringing 25W Qi2.2 to every wireless charging accessory, and that momentum will continue into 2026. Anker is leading the industry in this regard — their new portable MagSafe three-in-one charger packs 25W Qi2.2 support into an incredibly compact form factor.

To achieve 25W wireless charging, active cooling is almost essential. Nearly every 25W charger on the market includes this feature, and Anker's new foldable three-in-one charger is no exception.

The package includes a 45W charger and USB-C cable, which is indeed enough to charge your iPhone, AirPods and Apple Watch simultaneously. With this charging stand, you can get your iPhone 18 Pro to 50% in just 27 minutes.

Remember the MagSafe Duo? If you ever loved that product but were disappointed when Apple discontinued it, you might love this new offering. It's almost as portable as the MagSafe Duo, but with two key advantages: it can function as a stand, and it can charge three devices at once instead of two.

This charger has a rather interesting (though honestly not absolutely necessary) feature: the Apple Watch charger uses a pop-up design. It stays tucked away when folded; when you're ready to open it, just press it lightly and it pops out. I think this design is quite clever, and it also makes the product's premium price tag more reasonable.

The bottom line

Overall, if you're looking for a stylish and portable MagSafe three-in-one charger, Anker's new product is a safe bet. It has built-in active cooling, allowing you to charge your iPhone quickly without overheating or experiencing other issues that wireless charging can sometimes bring.

Anker's new three-in-one MagSafe charger is now available on Amazon for $99, with free shipping for Prime members, in black and white.
